title: tights,chulki pack
description: This resource pack replaces almost all armor elements with tights,and also adds minimal armor on top
body:
This resource pack replaces almost all armor elements with tights,and also adds minimal armor on top.For true femboys. And also for regular guys. We plan to refine other things in this resource pack in the future.Give your character some personality! 🧦✨
This pack replaces the default leg texture or overlay armor with neat, patterned, striped stockings."Stockings are no joke! 🧦
Optifine is not required
Suitable for 1.21.9-1.21.11
💾 Installation: Download the .zip file, place it in the resource packs folder, and activate it in the game. OptiFine is not required.
changes almost all armor
For questions and bugs, please contact the Discord server https://discord.gg/J3ekHKK6f
